# What marine electronics do I need for my sailboat?


October 22, 2026


### *Sail with confidence using state-of-the-art marine electronics and advanced sailing technology from Garmin*


Your sailboat is an investment that can provide a lifetime of enjoyment. With the right marine equipment, you can simplify navigation and improve your performance while also having more peace of mind.


Even if you’re a captain who doesn’t want an overcomplicated setup, adding one or two quality marine electronics can significantly improve and optimize your time on the water.


## What sailing products are right for me?


When it’s time to equip your boat for comfort, safety or compliance, you have endless options. Our[Marine System Builder](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/marine-system-builder/sailing/) can help you get started. If you’re overwhelmed with options, the following products are a great start:


### [GMI™ 40 wireless sail pack – 43 mm](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1912737/pn/010-03411-50/)


Get the data you need to help you[sail with efficiency](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/blog/marine/reading-the-wind-for-improved-sailing-with-garmin/) and ease. This complete package is a sailor’s dream, combining multiple core components for detailed, real-time wind, speed, depth, heading insights and more. Included are two[GMI 40 touchscreen marine instruments](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1849621/) , the[gWind™ Wireless 2](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/pn/010-01616-00/) and GDT™ 43/GST™ 43 transducers.


### [Reactor™ 40 sail corepack with SmartDrive™ and Display](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1960585/pn/010-02794-11/)


No matter the conditions, this autopilot corepack is designed to help you navigate with ease. The first sailboat autopilot with a brushless linear actuator, built-in ECU and rudder feedback sensor, SmartDrive is built with performance and durability in mind. SmartDrive delivers up to 1,050 lbs of maximum thrust and reacts quickly to water conditions when pitching and rolling. Fit for your sailboat or catamaran up to 45′ or 33,000 lbs displacement, count on this bundle for the long haul.


### [GPSMAP® series chartplotter](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/c/marine/chartplotters/?currentPage=1)


A powerful chartplotter helps you navigate so you can sail with confidence. Optional, built-in[Garmin Navionics®+](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/794783/pn/010-C1287-20/) or[Navionics Vision+™](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/794799/pn/010-C1289-00/) charts can be viewed on your chartplotter. Whether you want to plot waypoints or stay clear of depths that make it hard to sail, use your[nautical charts](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/blog/marine/new-garmin-marine-cartography-offers-all-in-one-mapping-solution/) to help prepare before or during your journey. Plus, integrate your chartplotter with other equipment onboard for a seamless experience thanks to NMEA 2000® and Garmin BlueNet™ networking.


### [GPSMAP 86sci](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/665244)


This handheld marine GPS provides everything you need for a safe day out on the water. With its built-in[inReach® satellite communicator](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/c/outdoor-recreation/handheld-hiking-gps/) 1, it also acts as an emergency beacon. Install it at your helm or take it with you to a different boat for portable marine navigation, made easy.


### [Garmin Signal™ VHF 400 marine radio](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1420541/)


A[marine radio](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/blog/marine/avoiding-a-boating-collision-using-ais-technology/) is an important communication and safety-enhancing electronic every sailboat should have — and this one transmits and receives AIS data with the help of the built-in AIS transponder for enhanced situational awareness and collision avoidance. View the vessel name, position, course and speed of nearby boaters.


### [GMR™ xHD3 r](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/951697/)[a](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/951697/)[dar](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/951697/)


For enhanced situational awareness on the water, a[Garmin radar](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/c/marine/boat-radars/) helps you avoid potential hazards and provides insights on changing conditions. Easily spot moving targets and objects thanks to sea filters, auto gain features and more.


## Garmin SailAssist sailing features


Garmin chartplotters are built with[sailing-specific features](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/garmin-technology/marine-technology/sailing/) to help you captain your boat.


### [Sailing polars](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/garmin-technology/marine-technology/sailing/polars/)


Should you bear off or trim the jib? Polar tables will take the guesswork out of trimming the sails and provide target boat speed and target wind angles unique to your boat, so you can always see how fast you should be sailing.


### [Data filtering](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/garmin-technology/marine-technology/sailing/data-filtering/)


Thanks to customizable data-filtering capabilities, you can set the system up exactly how you want to filter values for wind speed, drift and wind angle for easy interpretation.


Looking for[more SailAssist features](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/garmin-technology/marine-technology/sailing/) ? View laylines, race start guidance, enhanced wind rose, heading and course-over-ground lines, true wind data fields and tide/current/time slider, wind angle, set and drift, wind speed, polars and more on[compatible Garmin marine electronics.](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/c/marine/)


Sail while prepared to protect your investment for years to come. Enjoy peace of mind aboard your boat with[Garmin sailing electronics](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/c/marine/sailing/) at the helm.


1Active plan required. Some jurisdictions regulate or prohibit satellite communication devices; it is the user’s responsibility to know and follow all applicable laws.
